svg.title: Generalization of decisions computed with finite data and iterations
svg.desc: An illustrative quadratic problem has distinct empirical and underlying optima. A gradient method is stopped at a finite iterate, separating its numerical error from the shift caused by data. A second schematic plot shows a decreasing numerical contribution, a data-sensitivity contribution that grows with iteration, and their sum. The curves are conceptual examples, not measured performance or a general theorem.
